airspace.zh: 英國（北愛爾蘭）的無人機守則：飛行高度不得超過離地表最近點120公尺；水平距離至少離不相關的人50公尺，不得飛越人群；離住宅、商業、工業與休閒區至少150公尺（250公克以下及C0等級可例外）；不得未經許可進入機場的飛航限制區。巨人堤道與卡里克-a-里德由國民信託管理，國民信託不允許未經授權在其土地上操作無人機。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: UK Drone Code (Northern Ireland): never more than 120 m from the closest point of the surface; keep 50 m horizontally from uninvolved people and never fly over crowds; stay 150 m from residential, commercial, industrial and recreational areas (drones under 250 g and C0 class excepted); do not enter airport flight restriction zones without permission. The Giant's Causeway and Carrick-a-Rede are cared for by the National Trust, which does not permit unauthorised drone operation on its land. Check the current rules before any real flight.

girona.en: Girona wreck site, Port na Spaniagh

bushmills.note: Village and railway marker (55° 12.387′ N, 6° 31.409′ W)

tagline.zh-Hant: 芬恩的傳說、1693年的皇家學會、無敵艦隊沉船、水力電車，到1986年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Finn's legend, the Royal Society in 1693, an Armada wreck, a hydro-electric tramway and World Heritage in 1986

zh: 這裡是北愛爾蘭安特里姆郡的巨人堤道，
大約四萬根玄武岩柱，緊緊排在一起。
en: This is the Giant's Causeway in County Antrim, Northern Ireland:
about 40,000 interlocking basalt columns.

zh: 傳說愛爾蘭巨人芬恩，造了這條堤道，
要跨過北海峽，去和蘇格蘭巨人貝南多納決鬥。
en: Legend says the Irish giant Fionn mac Cumhaill built it across the North Channel
to fight the Scottish giant Benandonner.

zh: 另一個版本說，芬恩的妻子把他扮成嬰兒；
貝南多納嚇得逃回去，一路把堤道毀掉。
en: In another version Fionn's wife disguises him as a baby,
and Benandonner flees, tearing up the causeway behind him.

zh: 海峽對岸，蘇格蘭斯塔法島的芬加爾洞，
也有一模一樣的玄武岩柱。
en: Across the sea, Fingal's Cave on the Scottish isle of Staffa
has identical basalt columns.

zh: 1692年，德里主教威廉・金來到這裡；
隔年，布爾克利爵士向英國皇家學會發表了論文。
en: In 1692 Bishop William King of Derry visited;
the next year Sir Richard Bulkeley presented a paper to the Royal Society.

zh: 1739年，畫家蘇珊娜・德魯里畫下這裡的水彩，
1743年，這些畫被刻成了版畫。
en: In 1739 Susanna Drury painted watercolours of the Causeway,
engraved in 1743.

zh: 西邊的鄧路斯城堡，最早建於十三世紀，
1513年的文獻，記載它屬於麥奎蘭家族。
en: Dunluce Castle to the west was first built in the 13th century;
records of 1513 place it in McQuillan hands.

zh: 1584年，麥克唐奈家族的索利・博伊，
奪下了這座城堡。
en: In 1584 Sorley Boy MacDonnell
took the castle.

zh: 1588年10月26日，西班牙無敵艦隊的赫羅納號，
在暴風雨中撞上礁石，船上一千三百多人，只有九人生還。
en: On 26 October 1588 the Armada galleass Girona was wrecked in a storm;
of more than 1,300 aboard, nine survived.

zh: 船上的大砲，被裝到鄧路斯城堡的門樓；
貨物賣掉的錢，拿來整修城堡。
en: The Girona's guns were mounted in Dunluce's gatehouses,
and its cargo was sold to pay for restoring the castle.

zh: 1967到1968年，潛水員撈起當時最大的一批無敵艦隊寶藏；
今天收藏在貝爾法斯特的阿爾斯特博物館。
en: In 1967–68 divers raised the largest Armada treasure then known from the wreck;
it is on show at the Ulster Museum in Belfast.

zh: 1883年，從波特拉什到布希米爾斯的電車通車，
1887年延伸到巨人堤道。
en: In 1883 a tramway opened from Portrush to Bushmills,
and in 1887 it was extended to the Giant's Causeway.

zh: 它被稱為全世界第一條水力發電的電車，
一直開到1949年9月30日。
en: It is described as the world's first tramway powered by hydro-electricity,
and ran until 30 September 1949.

zh: 1961年，國民信託買下這裡；
1986年列入世界遺產，1987年成為國家自然保護區。
en: The National Trust acquired the site in 1961;
it became World Heritage in 1986 and a national nature reserve in 1987.

zh: 從巨人的傳說，到學者的論文，
三百多年來，人們一直來到這片岩柱前。
en: From the giants' legend to the scholars' papers,
people have been coming to these columns for more than 300 years.

tagline.zh-Hant: 近百萬名訪客、巨人的靴子與管風琴、失落的小鎮、《權力遊戲》與漁夫的索橋
tagline.en: Nearly a million visitors, the Giant's Boot and Organ, a lost town, Game of Thrones and a rope bridge

zh: 2019年，大約九十九萬八千人來到巨人堤道；
疫情期間少了九成五，2023年回到六十六萬三千人。
en: About 998,000 people visited the Giant's Causeway in 2019;
numbers fell 95% in the pandemic and reached 663,000 in 2023.

zh: 走進堤道本身不用錢，
遊客中心則要收費。
en: Access to the Causeway itself is free;
the visitor centre charges a fee.

zh: 1986年的遊客中心，在2000年燒毀；
新的遊客中心，到2012年才啟用。
en: The 1986 visitor centre burned down in 2000;
a new one opened only in 2012.

zh: 岩石有許多名字：巨人的靴子、巨人的眼睛、
牧羊人的階梯、蜂巢、巨人的豎琴、駱駝背。
en: The rocks have names: the Giant's Boot, the Giant's Eyes,
the Shepherd's Steps, the Honeycomb, the Giant's Harp and the Camel's Hump.

zh: 「巨人的管風琴」大約有六十根岩柱，
高十二公尺。
en: The Giant's Organ has about sixty columns,
12 metres high.

zh: 十八世紀的導遊，還講過另一個故事：
芬恩造這條堤道，是為了愛情。
en: Guides in the 1700s told another story:
that Finn built the Causeway for love.

zh: 1608年，城堡旁蓋起了一座小鎮，
街道排成棋盤格，房子裡可能還有室內廁所。
en: In 1608 a town was built beside the castle,
with a grid of streets and possibly indoor toilets.

zh: 這座小鎮在1641年的叛亂中被夷平；
2011年的考古發掘時，九成五還埋在地下。
en: The town was razed in the rebellion of 1641;
at the 2011 excavations about 95% of it was still undiscovered.

zh: 地方傳說，1639年一個暴風雨的夜裡，
城堡的廚房掉進了海裡。
en: Local tales say that one stormy night in 1639
the castle's kitchens fell into the sea.

zh: 影集《權力遊戲》用它的外景，
拍出葛雷喬伊家族的派克城。
en: Game of Thrones used its exterior
for Pyke, seat of House Greyjoy.

zh: 布希米爾斯的名字，來自布希河，
和十七世紀初蓋在河邊的一座大水車磨坊。
en: Bushmills takes its name from the River Bush
and a large watermill built there in the early 17th century.

zh: 2002年起，三公里多的窄軌蒸汽小火車，
沿著舊電車的路線，從村子開到巨人堤道。
en: Since 2002 a narrow-gauge steam train has run just over 3 km
along the old tramway route from the village to the Causeway.

zh: 東邊的卡里克-a-里德索橋，長二十公尺，
離下面的岩石有三十公尺高。
en: To the east, the Carrick-a-Rede rope bridge is 20 metres long
and 30 metres above the rocks below.

zh: 一般認為，捕鮭魚的漁夫三百五十多年來都在這裡搭橋；
2018年，有四十八萬五千多人走過它。
en: Salmon fishermen are thought to have built bridges here for over 350 years;
in 2018 more than 485,000 people crossed it.

zh: 巨人、城堡、沉船與漁夫，
都把故事留在了這段海岸上。
en: Giants, castles, shipwrecks and fishermen
have all left their stories on this coast.

title.en: Birds and Flowers of the Cliffs

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩百種植物、八十種鳥、海豹與水獺、受保護的小蝸牛，與越來越少的刀嘴海雀
tagline.en: 200 plant species, 80 kinds of bird, seals and otters, a protected snail and declining razorbills

zh: 巨人堤道的海崖上，大約長著兩百種植物，
包括紅列當、海鐵角蕨與蛙蘭。
en: About 200 plant species grow on the Causeway's cliffs,
including red broomrape, sea spleenwort and frog orchid.

zh: 還有兔腳三葉草、春綿棗兒，
和海羊茅。
en: There are also hare's-foot trefoil, vernal squill
and sea fescue.

zh: 這裡有五十種留鳥，和三十種過境的鳥，
包括刀嘴海雀、暴風海燕與遊隼。
en: Fifty resident and thirty migrant bird species are found here,
including razorbills, European storm petrels and peregrine falcons.

zh: 海鳥還有暴雪鸌、鸕鷀、歐鸕鷀，
紅腳鷸和海鴉。
en: Other seabirds include fulmars, cormorants, shags,
redshanks and guillemots.

zh: 海裡住著灰海豹和歐亞水獺，
瓶鼻海豚也會游過這片海岸。
en: Grey seals and European otters live in these waters,
and bottlenose dolphins pass along the coast.

zh: 小小的窄口螺旋蝸牛，
受到歐盟棲地指令的保護。
en: The tiny narrow-mouthed whorl snail
is protected under the EU Habitats Directive.

zh: 2011年10月，這裡還發現了
一群疊層石，由微生物一層層堆起。
en: In October 2011 a colony of stromatolites,
layered structures built by microbes, was reported here.

zh: 東邊的羊島鳥類保護區，
刀嘴海雀的數量，正在減少。
en: At Sheep Island special protection area to the east
razorbill numbers are declining.

zh: 1960年代，這裡的漁夫一天能捕到近三百條鮭魚；
到2002年，整季只捕到兩百五十條。
en: In the 1960s fishermen here caught almost 300 salmon a day;
by 2002 they caught 250 in the whole season.

zh: 1987年，海岸成為國家自然保護區；
1989年，堤道上方的台地列為傑出自然美景區。
en: The coast became a national nature reserve in 1987;
the plateau above was made an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty in 1989.

zh: 世界自然保護聯盟2025年的評估：
前景「良好，但有些問題要注意」。
en: IUCN's 2025 assessment
rated the outlook as "good, with some concerns".

zh: 氣候變遷可能加劇海岸侵蝕，
崩塌與落石的風險，也在升高。
en: Climate change may increase coastal erosion,
and the risk of slides and rockfalls is rising.

zh: 有些遊客把硬幣塞進岩縫，
也被列為需要注意的破壞。
en: Some visitors wedge coins into the cracks of the stones,
a kind of vandalism that is a concern.

zh: 周圍的景觀，法律保護比較弱；
離岸風電與石油探勘，被列為潛在的威脅。
en: The surrounding landscape has weaker legal protection,
and offshore wind and petroleum exploration are potential threats.

zh: 海鳥、海豹與岩縫裡的小花，
和這些岩柱一起，面對北大西洋的風浪。
en: Seabirds, seals and the small flowers in the cracks
face the North Atlantic together with the columns.

title.en: Lava from Sixty Million Years Ago

tagline.zh-Hant: 古新世的噴發、紅土夾層、九道熔岩流、緩慢冷卻出的六角柱，與火山頸變成的小島
tagline.en: Paleocene eruptions, a laterite layer, nine lava flows, slow-cooled columns and a volcanic-plug island

zh: 巨人堤道形成在五千萬到六千萬年前的古新世，
當時愛爾蘭還和北美洲連在一起。
en: The Causeway formed 50 to 60 million years ago, in the Paleocene,
when Ireland was still attached to North America.

zh: 非常稀的玄武岩熔岩，穿過白堊層湧出，
堆成了一片火山高原。
en: Highly fluid basalt lava pushed up through beds of chalk
and built a volcanic plateau.

zh: 最下面的下玄武岩組，大約六千二百六十萬年前，
最厚可達五百三十一公尺。
en: The Lower Basalt Formation, about 62.6 million years old,
is up to 531 metres thick.

zh: 上面是一層約三十公尺厚的紅土，
記錄了火山長期停歇、岩石深度風化的年代。
en: Above it lies a laterite about 30 metres thick,
recording a long pause in the eruptions and deep weathering.

zh: 再上面的上玄武岩組，約五千九百六十萬年前，
最厚三百四十六公尺。
en: The Upper Basalt Formation above, about 59.6 million years old,
is up to 346 metres thick.

zh: 形成岩柱的「堤道拉斑玄武岩」，
是九道熔岩流，積在一處窪地，最厚三十公尺。
en: The Causeway Tholeiite that forms the columns
is nine lava flows that ponded in a hollow, up to 30 metres thick.

zh: 這麼厚的熔岩，冷卻得很慢，
才能裂出近乎完美的岩柱。
en: Lava that thick cooled slowly,
which allowed nearly perfect columns to crack apart.

zh: 熔岩冷卻時收縮、裂開，
岩柱的粗細，主要取決於冷卻的速度。
en: As the lava cooled it contracted and cracked;
the size of the columns depended mainly on how fast it cooled.

zh: 大多數岩柱是六角形，
也有四邊、五邊、七邊和八邊的。
en: Most of the columns are hexagonal;
some have four, five, seven or eight sides.

zh: 岩柱平均直徑約四十五公分，最高大約十二公尺；
海崖上的熔岩，有些地方厚達二十八公尺。
en: The columns average 45 cm across and reach about 12 metres;
the lava in the cliffs is 28 metres thick in places.

zh: 下層整齊的岩柱叫做「柱列」，
上層破碎的玄武岩，叫做「柱頂層」。
en: The neat lower columns are called the colonnade,
and the broken basalt above them the entablature.

zh: 卡里克-a-里德島，是北愛爾蘭最好的火山頸，
海浪侵蝕，露出了古老火山的通道。
en: Carrickarede island is the best volcanic plug in Northern Ireland:
the sea has worn away the rock to expose an old volcanic neck.

zh: 靠海的一面是堅硬的輝綠岩，後面是比較軟的凝灰岩；
周圍的玄武岩海崖下，墊著白堊。
en: Hard dolerite faces the sea, with softer tuff behind it;
the basalt cliffs around it sit on chalk.

zh: 世界遺產的範圍只有七十公頃，
堤道海岸的傑出自然美景區，長約二十九公里。
en: The World Heritage site covers just 70 hectares;
the Causeway Coast Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty runs for about 29 km.

zh: 三百年來，地質學家在這裡讀著熔岩的紀錄，
巨人的堤道，其實是一部地球的歷史。
en: For three hundred years geologists have read the lava here;
the giant's causeway is really a history of the Earth.
